requirement: The Board shall establish a clear governance structure with defined roles and responsibilities for its members and committees.
source: SAMA Key Principles of Governance in Financial Institutions (Version 2, 2024)
evidence_expected: Documented governance framework, board charter, committee terms of reference.

requirement: The institution must establish an independent compliance function with clearly defined responsibilities, authority, and adequate resources.
source: SAMA Key Principles of Governance in Financial Institutions (Version 2, 2024)
evidence_expected: Compliance charter, reporting lines, resource allocation documentation.

requirement: The Board shall develop, approve, and monitor the implementation of a comprehensive risk management strategy aligned with the institution's risk appetite.
source: SAMA Key Principles of Governance in Financial Institutions (Version 2, 2024)
evidence_expected: Risk management policy, risk appetite statement, annual review records.

requirement: The institution shall maintain effective internal control mechanisms including sound administrative and accounting procedures.
source: SAMA Key Principles of Governance in Financial Institutions (Version 2, 2024)
evidence_expected: Internal control framework, internal audit charter, control testing reports.

requirement: The Board shall ensure the independence of the internal audit function and its direct reporting line to the Audit Committee.
source: SAMA Key Principles of Governance in Financial Institutions (Version 2, 2024)
evidence_expected: Internal audit charter, reporting structure, audit committee minutes.

requirement: The institution must maintain a documented policy review process with a defined review frequency.
source: SAMA Key Principles of Governance in Financial Institutions (Version 2, 2024)
evidence_expected: Policy review schedule, version control records, approval workflow.

requirement: The Board shall conduct regular self-assessments of its performance and effectiveness.
source: SAMA Key Principles of Governance in Financial Institutions (Version 2, 2024)
evidence_expected: Board evaluation records, assessment criteria, action plans.

requirement: The institution shall establish policies and procedures for protecting whistleblowers and resolving complaints from stakeholders.
source: SAMA Key Principles of Governance in Financial Institutions (Version 2, 2024)
evidence_expected: Whistleblower protection policy, complaints handling procedures, reporting channels.

requirement: The institution shall maintain adequate documentation of all governance decisions and board proceedings.
source: SAMA Key Principles of Governance in Financial Institutions (Version 2, 2024)
evidence_expected: Meeting minutes, decision logs, document retention policy.

requirement: The Board shall establish a clear and transparent remuneration policy for senior management and board members.
source: SAMA Key Principles of Governance in Financial Institutions (Version 2, 2024)
evidence_expected: Remuneration policy, compensation committee charter, approval process.
